summary: The prepared source already contains the issue-specific fix from upstream PR #32818 (merge e5c46ff07d7859ceee9d2e59cb03e1bc3ecff118): on SM100, asymmetric-K/V MHA models such as MiMo-V2.5 resolve to fa4 instead of the incompatible trtllm_mha backend. No duplicate runtime change was made.

tests.what_was_measured: Deterministic resolver assertions: asymmetric 192/128-style MHA -> fa4; symmetric MHA -> trtllm_mha; asymmetric MHA with speculative top-k 2 -> flashinfer. This simulated platform facts and did not execute SM100 kernels.
Current MiMo model override declarations and SM100 FP8 MoE selection; 3 passed, 91 deselected.
Real gfx950 execution of asymmetric KV allocation and fused cache writes, including MiMo 192/128, reversed and symmetric boundary cases; 8 tests and 9 subtests passed.
Broader diagnostic run: 90 passed and 4 unrelated platform-sensitive tests failed under ROCm. Raw failure output is retained and is not treated as issue evidence.

gpu_execution.evidence: Assigned GPU was AMD Instinct MI355X, gfx950, ROCm 7.2. The asymmetric MHA pool device suite executed on GPU and passed; see raw/gpu_environment.txt and raw/test_asymmetric_mha_pool.txt.

remaining_limitations: MiMo-V2.5 weights were unavailable, so no full-model or accuracy validation was performed.
Only one AMD gfx950 GPU was assigned; the reported four-GPU NVIDIA SM100/SM103 TP=4 CUDA graph deployment could not be reproduced.
The real GPU evidence covers the relevant asymmetric cache path on ROCm, not the CUDA TRT-LLM or FA4 kernels.
The full model-override suite has four unrelated ROCm/platform-assumption failures; the issue-specific MiMo subset passes.
